onboarding.welcomeBody: Scan a merchant's QR code and pay in FTC. Your wallet lives on this phone — nothing leaves the device until you confirm a payment.
onboarding.feature2: Your keys stay on your phone
onboarding.feature3: Every payment kept as a receipt
onboarding.doneBody: Your wallet is set up and secured on this device. Scan a merchant's QR code to make your first payment.

home.scanHint: Point your camera at a merchant's QR code
home.noPaymentsBody: Your payments will appear here once you've paid a merchant.

scan.title: Scan to pay
scan.hint: Point at the merchant's QR code
scan.cameraErrorBody: ANTON Pay couldn't open the camera. Check the app's camera permission, or enter the payment code manually.
scan.manualHint: Paste the futurechain:pay link from the merchant.
scan.invalidUri: That isn't a valid ANTON payment code.
scan.invalidUriExpired: This payment code has expired. Ask the merchant for a fresh QR.

review.title: Review payment
review.expiredBody: This QR code is no longer valid. Ask the merchant to show you a fresh one.

iso.title: ISO 20022 payment details
iso.note: This payment maps to an ISO 20022 PACS.008 credit transfer. Add your details in Settings → Payment details.

paymentDone.title: Payment recorded
paymentDone.body: Your payment has been recorded on this device. The merchant settles it through Safello.

history.title: Payment history
history.emptyBody: Once you pay a merchant, every payment is kept here as a receipt.

settings.title: Settings
settings.paymentDetailsSub: Your name and address for payment records
settings.appearanceHelp: Pick an accent colour and a light or dark theme.
settings.resetHelp: Erases your wallet and every payment record from this device. This cannot be undone — make sure you no longer need the wallet.
settings.resetConfirm: Reset the app? This permanently erases your wallet and all payment records on this device. This cannot be undone.

wallet.title: Your wallet
wallet.addressHelp: Share this address to receive FTC. It is safe to show — only your private key can spend from it.
wallet.keyNote: Your private key is held in this phone's secure storage and never leaves the device.
wallet.noWalletBody: Create a wallet to start paying merchants.

paymentDetails.title: Payment details
paymentDetails.subtitle: Your name and address are added to the ISO 20022 record of every payment you make. All fields are optional.
paymentDetails.name: Full name
paymentDetails.privacyNote: These details stay on this phone. They are only used to fill the payment record — ANTON Pay never sends them anywhere on its own.
